video_title: Your VA Loan Could Pay You in 2026
evidence_excerpt: Title: “Your VA Loan Could Pay You in 2026.” Captions: “your VA loan can actually make you money.” Description: it can “generate income, build equity faster, and create long-term wealth.”
topic: TREC Rule § 535.155 financial/outcome-claim substantiation and VA-loan education review
classification: High-risk potential concern: unqualified financial/outcome claim review; not a Regulation Z, VA, RESPA, or legal-violation finding
material_caveat: The short gives no factual basis for the claimed income/wealth result or the relevant ownership, occupancy, entitlement, lender, financing, rent, expense, tax, market, or timeframe assumptions. It does not establish a creditor advertisement, loan availability, compensation, referral agreement, VA-program breach, or consumer outcome.
recommended_follow_up: Use conditional educational language and disclose the material scenario assumptions, costs, risks, and eligibility constraints; retain support for any stated income/equity result and route the final asset through broker/lender compliance review.
